descriptionByLocale.it:
Fondata nel 1894, Universal Genève ha sempre legato arte, architettura e prestigio orologiero. Oggi stiamo entrando in una nuova era. Riinterpretati da una prospettiva contemporanea, le icone leggendarie della Maison rivelano un raffinato equilibrio tra bellezza funzionale, precisione progettuale e maestria meccanica. Per coloro che sono pronti a costruire una Legacy: se siete un leader proattivo che comprende il mercato dell'orologio di lusso e cerca di costruire qualcosa di veramente storico, vi invitiamo a unirsi a noi nel nostro rilancio. Si svolgerà un ruolo essenziale nell'apertura di un capitolo completamente nuovo per "Le Couturier de la Montre" come stabiliamo la nostra fondazione di vendita al dettaglio globale nella prestigiosa città di Ginevra. Il leader che cerchiamo Sei un leader ispiratore e un self-starter pronto per una vera sfida imprenditoriale. Come direttore della Flagship Boutique per la nostra boutique di Ginevra, siete al centro della rinascita storica di Universal Genève. Siccome questa è la prima boutique ad essere fondata per il marchio in tutto il mondo, si sta intensificando per definire l'identità della nave ammiraglia e costruire il team da zero, selezionando e conducendo un Assistant Boutique Director e un team di Client Advisors per portare a vita questa nuova era. La tua esperienza cliente artigianale & Hospitality · Potrai agire come l'ospite perfetto, offrendo un'esperienza cliente eccezionale e personalizzata per la clientela locale e internazionale dove ogni gesto è unico su misura, mai off-the-rack o script. · Potrai consegnare un viaggio filettato, guidando il rapporto senza soluzione di continuità dalla prima indagine alla consegna finale con assolutamente nessun handoffs. · Saprete come leggere la stanza per anticipare l'umore e la raccolta del cliente, costruendo strategie di clientela su misura per aumentare la fedeltà. · Prenderai la completa proprietà come master in recupero di servizio, assicurando che se sorge un problema, lo “stitch” prima che il cliente lo bandi. Espansione della Legacy · Lei agirà come nostro ambasciatore del marchio primario, rappresentante Universal Genève al più alto livello per introdurre il marchio rinato ad un cerchio esclusivo. · Costruirete partnership strategiche attive e di alto livello con l'ecosistema di élite di Ginevra per rendere la nave ammiraglia una destinazione altamente raccomandata. · Potrai progettare e ospitare visualizzazioni private altamente esclusive e esperienze su misura che mostrano la nostra maestria meccanica. · Coltiverete la crescita proattiva identificando e collegando con individui di alto valore, promuovendo contatti influenti in tutta la città. Commerciale & Eccellenza Operativa · Lei guiderà un business cliente di alto valore, assumendo la piena proprietà P&L e agendo come un vero imprenditore per garantire il successo commerciale della nave ammiraglia. · Monitorerai le tendenze del mercato e le metriche aziendali, adattando le strategie basate sui dati per superare costantemente gli obiettivi finanziari. · Potrai supervisionare le operazioni quotidiane, l'inventario e la sicurezza boutique per mantenere un ambiente di back-of-house impeccabile e standard. Team Leadership & Development · Potrai collaborare con la Maison per reclutare e costruire un team da zero, supervisionando un team di consulenti clienti e un concierge che incarna perfettamente il marchio. · Sei un leader ispiratore e proattivo che eleva l'artigianato e respira la vita nella cultura di prestigio della Maison. · Potrai allenare e mentore il team direttamente sul piano boutique, affinando le loro competenze nella gestione delle relazioni e l'ospitalità di fascia alta. · Potrai garantire una collaborazione senza interruzioni con il team UG HQ e la conciergerie, mantenendo la nostra visione strategica in tutte le interazioni. Che cosa vi farà successo · Porti almeno 8 anni in un ruolo di leadership senior supervisionando un ambiente di vendita al dettaglio di lusso. Mentre uno sfondo in orologeria fine è preferito, un record di traccia eccezionale in alta gioielleria, ospitalità o moda di lusso è altamente apprezzato. · Possiedi una profonda comprensione del mercato dell'orologio di lusso e hai una comprovata traccia di guida di affari clienti di alto valore. · Porti una profonda conoscenza del mercato di Ginevra e Svizzera. Una rete locale consolidata è considerata un vantaggio distinto. · Sei un vero esperto nella gestione delle relazioni e della clientela. Fornisci un'esperienza cliente eccezionale e personalizzata e strategie di design su misura per aumentare la fedeltà tra i tuoi collezionisti. · Sei completamente fluente in francese e inglese. Le lingue aggiuntive sono un plus. · Sei un comunicatore eloquente e raffinato. Si articola la visione rinata della Maison in modo impeccabile sia per collezionisti esclusivi che per team interni. Ogni magnifico risveglio richiede un visionario per guidarlo. Se siete pronti a misurare, tagliare e cucire il futuro della nostra eccellenza al dettaglio, vi invitiamo a modellare la visione della nostra ammiraglia di Ginevra. Unisciti a Universal Genève e crea un'esperienza indimenticabile per i collezionisti più esigenti del mondo. Il tuo nuovo datore di lavoro: Incoraggiamo tutti a portare vera autenticità al lavoro e contribuire alla nostra missione condivisa per ridefinire il lusso. Prepariamo il benessere dei nostri dipendenti promuovendo un ambiente di diversità, equità e inclusione, dove ogni voce viene ascoltata e valutata. Crediamo che i dipendenti felici e sani siano la chiave per il successo, ecco perché offriamo vantaggi competitivi, tra cui:
• Home office (a seconda dei requisiti di posizione)
• Programma di riferimento
• Opportunità di sviluppo
• Cultura del feedback Vuoi partecipare a questa missione? Applicare ora!
descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1894, Universal Genève has always linked art, architecture, and watchmaking prestige. Today, we are entering a new era. Reinterpreted from a contemporary perspective, the Maison's legendary icons reveal a refined balance between functional beauty, design precision, and mechanical mastery. For Those Ready To Build A Legacy: If you are a proactive leader who understands the luxury watch market and seeks to build something truly historic, we invite you to join us in our revival. You will play an essential role in opening a completely new chapter for "Le Couturier de la Montre" as we establish our global retail foundation in the prestigious city of Geneva.

The Leader We Seek You are an inspirational leader and a self-starter ready for a true entrepreneurial challenge. As the Flagship Boutique Director for our Geneva boutique, you are at the center of Universal Genève’s historic revival. Because this is the very first boutique to be established for the brand worldwide, you are stepping in to define the flagship’s identity and build the team from the ground up, selecting and leading an Assistant Boutique Director and a team of Client Advisors to bring this new era to life. Your Craft Client Experience & Hospitality · You will act as the perfect host, delivering exceptional, personalized client experience for local and international clientele where every gesture is uniquely tailored, never off-the-rack or scripted. · You will deliver a threaded journey, guiding the relationship seamlessly from first inquiry to final delivery with absolutely no handoffs. · You will know how to read the room to anticipate the client's mood and collection, building bespoke clienteling strategies to boost loyalty. · You will take complete ownership as a master’s in service recovery, ensuring that if an issue arises, you “stitch” it before the client even flags it. Expanding the Legacy · You will act as our primary brand ambassador, representing Universal Genève at the highest level to introduce the reborn brand to an exclusive circle. · You will build active, high-level strategic partnerships with Geneva's elite ecosystem to make the flagship a highly recommended destination. · You will design and host highly exclusive private viewings and tailored experiences that showcase our mechanical mastery. · You will cultivate proactive growth by identifying and connecting with high-value individuals, fostering influential contacts across the city. Commercial & Operational Excellence · You will drive a high-value client business, taking full P&L ownership and acting as a true entrepreneur to ensure the flagship's commercial success. · You will monitor market trends and business metrics, adapting strategies based on data to consistently exceed financial targets. · You will oversee daily operations, inventory, and boutique security to maintain a flawless, high-standard back-of-house environment. Team Leadership & Development · You will partner with the Maison to recruit and build a team from scratch, overseeing a team of client advisors and a concierge who perfectly embody the brand. · You are an inspirational, proactive leader who elevates the craft and breathes life into the Maison's culture of prestige. · You will coach and mentor the team directly on the boutique floor, refining their skills in relationship management and high-end hospitality. · You will ensure seamless cross-department collaboration with the UG HQ team and the conciergerie, upholding our strategic vision in all interactions. What Will Make You Successful · You bring at least 8 years in a senior leadership role overseeing a luxury retail environment. While a background in fine watchmaking is preferred, an exceptional track record in high jewelry, hospitality or luxury fashion is highly valued. · You possess a deep understanding of the luxury watch market and have a proven track record of driving high-value client business. · You bring a profound knowledge of the Geneva and Swiss market. An established local network is considered a distinct advantage. · You are a true expert in relationship management and clienteling. You deliver exceptional, personalized client experience and design bespoke clienteling strategies to boost loyalty among your collectors. · You are completely fluent in French and English. Additional languages are a plus. · You are an eloquent, refined communicator. You articulate the Maison's reborn vision flawlessly to both exclusive collectors and internal teams. Tailor a New Legacy Every magnificent revival requires a visionary to guide it. If you are ready to measure, cut, and stitch the future of our retail excellence, we invite you to shape the vision of our Geneva flagship. Join Universal Genève, and craft an unforgettable experience for the world's most discerning collectors.

Your new employer: We encourage everyone to bring true authenticity to work and contribute to our shared mission to redefine luxury. We prioritize the well-being of our employees by fostering an environment of diversity, equity and inclusion, where every voice is heard and valued. We believe that happy, healthy employees are the key to success, which is why we offer competitive benefits, including:
• Home office (depending on position requirements)
• Referral program
• Development opportunities
• Culture of feedback Want to take on this mission and join our team? Apply now!

Sie werden eine wesentliche Rolle dabei spielen, ein völlig neues Kapitel für "Le Couturier de la Montre" zu eröffnen, wenn wir unsere globale Einzelhandelsstiftung in der angesehenen Stadt Genf gründen. Der Anführer, den wir suchen Sie sind eine inspirierende Führungskraft und ein Selbststarter, der bereit ist für eine echte unternehmerische Herausforderung. Sie überwachen Markttrends und Geschäftsmetriken und passen Strategien basierend auf Daten an, um die finanziellen Ziele konsequent zu übertreffen. Ein etabliertes lokales Netzwerk wird als deutlicher Vorteil angesehen. · Sie sind ein echter Experte für Beziehungsmanagement und Kundenbindung. Sie liefern eine außergewöhnliche, personalisierte Kundenerfahrung und entwerfen maßgeschneiderte Kundenstrategien, um die Loyalität unter Ihren Sammlern zu steigern. · Sie sind völlig fließend in Französisch und Englisch. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die Zukunft unserer Exzellenz im Einzelhandel zu messen, zu schneiden und zu nähen, laden wir Sie ein, die Vision unseres Genfer Flaggschiffs zu gestalten. Treten Sie Universal Genève bei und schaffen Sie ein unvergessliches Erlebnis für die anspruchsvollsten Sammler der Welt. descriptionByLocale.en:
We are a dedicated Squad on a mission to redefine Swiss watchmaking, rooted in our legacy since 1884. Driven by innovation and precision we create timepieces that combine modern-retro design with casual, approachable, and sustainable luxury — powered by passionate teams around the world. Join our vibrant team in Zurich as a Content Specialist (f/m/x) and be part of something extraordinary! As a Content Specialist (f/m/x) , you will support the delivery of engaging and high-performing digital experiences across our global websites. You will manage website content, coordinate product launches and campaigns, and work closely with Marketing, E-commerce, Creative, and Tech teams to bring initiatives to life. This role is ideal for someone who combines technical website expertise with a business mindset, is comfortable with digital tools, and enjoys working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Your contribution:
• You will manage and publish website content using our CMS, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and a premium brand experience.
• You will support global product launches, promotional campaigns, and seasonal initiatives across multiple markets.
• You will build and maintain landing pages, banners, and other web assets, balancing visual quality with UX best practices.
• You will perform basic asset retouching and adaptations, including image cropping, resizing, background edits, and content preparation for web use.
• You will coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective digital solutions.
• You will proactively identify website content issues, bugs, and opportunities for improvement, translate findings into clear business and functional requirements, and create well-defined tickets to support efficient prioritization and implementation by Tech team.
• You will contribute to site navigation, merchandising, and content optimization activities.
• You will manage tasks and workflows through Jira and other project management tools.
• You will leverage AI-powered tools to streamline workflows and improve day-to-day efficiency. Do you think there is even more to discover in this role? You're right — apply today and learn more! You will fit well to our squad if you have:
• 2–3 years of experience in content management, e-commerce, digital marketing, or a similar role.
• Hands-on experience with CMS platforms (Contentful experience is a plus).
• Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, with the ability to independently retouch and adapt digital assets for web publication.
• Experience using Jira or similar project management tools in a cross-functional environment.
• A good balance of technical aptitude and commercial awareness.
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proactive and solution oriented mindset.
• Hands-on experience working with PIM and DAM platforms and their role in supporting efficient content operations and omnichannel consistency.
• Familiarity with HTML/CSS and an understanding of web technologies are a plus.
• Exposure to web analytics, CRO, SEO, or UX principles is an advantage.
• Curiosity and enthusiasm for using AI tools to enhance productivity and optimize workflows. We invite you to apply even if you do not meet all of these criteria.

• Care – We look after our people, our clients, and our planet, with respect and responsibility. Want to take on this mission and join our #Squad? Apply now! We welcome applications from all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We invite candidates from all walks of life to share their applications to join our Squad, where inclusion is at the heart of our vision of elegance and prestige.
